finding: Combinational logic detected before a synchronizer
reviewed_findings.rationale: Actual destination is the first FDCE/FDPE stage of vendor xpm_cdc_async_rst, with ASYNC_REG=1 and PCIe user clock period 4ns. Generated PCIe source combines sys_rst_n with link/hot-reset state before its async reset synchronizers (DEST_SYNC_FF=2), accounting for the combinational-logic warning. The added upstream fundamental reset has a three-stage sys_clock100 release synchronizer and 10000-cycle qualification, but that qualification does not cover vendor-internal hot-reset/link-down causes. This explains the reset synchronizer structure only and is not full reset protocol or board signoff.
reviewed_findings.fixed_observation: Separately queried this finding destination in the fixed actual routed DCP; primitive/attributes/clock/fanin match the original observation. This is not acceptance or transfer of original peer review.

finding: Clock enable controlled CDC structure detected
reviewed_findings.rationale: Actual destinations are APB55 FDCE 13-bit debounce CLR or FDPE deglitch PRE, with fanin from PCIe user_reset, power-on reset and PLL LOCKED. ResetWrangler selects the slowest input (55 MHz), qualifies deassertion for 5500 ticks and sends deglitched reset to per-domain ResetCatchAndSync. PCIe user_reset includes runtime hot-reset, link-down, PHY-link state and ds_pulse causes, so this is an asynchronous reset-qualification structure, not solely a cold-reset source or a multibit application-data transfer. This explains these 28 findings structurally only; it does not resolve missing ASYNC_REG on the downstream PCIe release chain, prove analog behavior, or establish all runtime-reset protocols.
